text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After pushing ourselves to the absolute limit,
the final day of summer training camp has arrivedâ

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Ugh... ngh!
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Just one more push!
What's wrong? Just one last push!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Y... es...! ...Aaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Verxina kept on running until the very last moment before departure.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
What's my time...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, once one has grown to a certain extent,
breaking records isn't something done so easily.
Yet she pulled it off through sheer, monumental effort.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Thank you very much!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's get ready to head home!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um, this is... for you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you, Shion-san.
That was a big help.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No...
I'm just glad the timing worked out so well.
choice_data_list: (Or rather... was she waiting for the right moment?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Win Variation had been secretly watching the training... but I decided not to bring it up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um, that was some incredible drive. And to beat your personal best on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I gave it everything I had, right to the very brink of my limits!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...That look really does suit you better after all."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be rooting for you at the Shuka Sho.
—Make sure you shatter that 'absolute'!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, please leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our preparations,
we hurried onto the bus...
and after some time passed—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —...Zzz, zzz...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
Big sis... did you fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
That's rare...
choice_data_list: You've worked that hard, after all.
You've worked that hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I seeee...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Good work, Big Sis♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Verxina had a good talk with her younger
sisters, as any look of worry had completely vanished
from their faces.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hup, I'm sticking close to youâ¡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
You'll wake them up...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's okay~, she's fast asleep!
Cheval-chi, you take the other side, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh* Fine, but
I'm not clinging to you...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Mumble mumble...
Hehehe... So sparkly...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
*Zzz*... *zzz*...
*Chuckle*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sight of the three sisters snuggling together in their sleep is truly heartwarming and sweet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that all her hard work up to this point will be rewarded,
I vowed to give her my full support in the time remaining
before the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, look who finally decided to grace us with her presence.
Orfevre-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if taking up the rear with such leisure
is a privilege reserved for Classic Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you glad that didn't
happen during a race?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...That look on your face
is getting on my nerves."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What is your business?
Insolent fool.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
Just a little consideration on my part.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So that our delicate king...
does not cower at a sudden revolution and make an unsightly scene.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What did you say?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Your reign ends here.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The next "summit" will be claimed by me...
Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall also grant you
my royal mercy."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—If you get too greedy,
you'll end up tripping yourself up.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho.
Did you really think I'd advance without leaving my mark?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—One person.
There is someone trying to pull me down, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured. I shall dust off the dirt
and show you I can reach it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Right at your throat.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
Ohohoho...!!
